title: Backend REST API Reconnaissance: radblok-api.onrender.com & Mongoose Model Discovery
summary: Reconnaissance shifted to the newly enabled backend application at https://radblok-api.onrender.com. Layer 7 HTTP analysis identified a live Node.js/Express service interacting with a MongoDB database (evidenced by Mongoose ObjectIds and __v fields) and Cloudinary media assets. Successfully mapped public endpoints (/api, /api/users, /api/posts) revealing application structure, user metadata, and content architecture.

blocks.text: Probing `https://radblok-api.onrender.com` confirmed that unlike the suspended frontend, the backend Render service is active and communicating with its origin:

blocks.label: curl
blocks.text:
$ curl -IL https://radblok-api.onrender.com/api
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
access-control-allow-credentials: true
access-control-allow-methods: GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE
x-powered-by: Express
x-render-origin-server: Render
Server: cloudflare
CF-RAY: ...-CPT

Welcome to radblok API
The presence of `x-render-origin-server: Render` and the absence of `x-render-routing: suspend-by-user` confirms the backend web process is awake and executing requests.
Testing common REST API routes exposed several active endpoints returning structured JSON data:

head: Endpoint
HTTP Status
Response / Architecture Clues
rows: `Welcome to radblok API` — Root API health string.
JSON array disclosing author profiles: `name`, `email` (`leecpt@gmail.com`), `posts` count, and Cloudinary avatar URI.
JSON object returning `total: 3` and post array with titles ('Bring in the Master!', 'Back On The Line'), HTML content, and timestamps.

items: **Database Layer**: **MongoDB** with **Mongoose ODM** — indicated by 24-character hexadecimal `_id` values (e.g. `68bb71563cab34b0badf6cbe`) and the internal Mongoose versioning attribute `__v: 0`.
**Media Storage**: **Cloudinary** CDN (`res.cloudinary.com/dhdc57kw9/...`) for user avatars and article thumbnails.
**Edge / Network**: **Cloudflare** Cape Town PoP (`CPT`) providing TLS termination and reverse proxying to Render PaaS.

blocks.text: 1. **User Metadata Disclosure**: The `GET /api/users` endpoint returns author emails and MongoDB internal IDs without authentication. In pen-testing scopes, this provides valid usernames for brute-force or credential stuffing against authentication endpoints.

2. **CORS Configuration**: `access-control-allow-credentials: true` is enabled. Once the frontend `radblok.co.za` is reactivated, origin verification on cookies and tokens can be audited for cross-origin risks.
